items.content: 2026-11-12 all-tree upgrade audit: openplanter NO upgrade (match_reference miss 2.55ms/call but ~4% of rebuild at 17-file scale; Rust trigger: registry past ~2000 entries miss-heavy); jev-ultrafast NO upgrade (IO-bound CDP/LLM, fingerprint already Go); armada NO upgrade (C#/TS, zero Python); mindwalk NO perf upgrade (already Go) but 7 Windows test failures fixed (normalizePath POSIX-rooted paths anchored to cwd volume; git.bat shim; 3 OS-impossible fixtures gated with reasons); board 2s PAMS probe tax FIXED via PAMS_PROBE_TIMEOUT=0.4s (board stats 3.5s -> 0.79s wall). PMB backend healthy (gate 9 PASS); record blocked only by stale client MCP session, cleared by restart.

Board CLI latency was a network timeout, not compute: MemoryBus.__init__ probes GET /api/health with PAMS_TIMEOUT=2.0s against whatever _resolve_pams_url returns (here a 15-day-old G: port file naming dead 21436; 21434 equally dead). cProfile: 2.002s of 2.365s in one socket connect; SQLite work 48ms. Fix keeps PAMS_TIMEOUT for API traffic and probes with 0.4s.
items.summary: Board 2s PAMS probe tax: cause and fix

items.content: mindwalk normalizePath treated POSIX-rooted paths as relative on Windows (IsAbs false for volume-less rooted paths), leaking /repo/src/main.go into the map instead of resolving to src/main.go or an outside touch. Fix anchors rooted paths to the cwd volume before Rel. Test fixtures that the OS forbids (quote in dirname, chmod-deny on Windows) are GOOS-gated with reasons, not weakened; the git-timeout test uses a git.bat shim on Windows since extensionless sh shims never execute there.

Upgrade candidates with a documented trigger but no action today: openplanter match_reference steps 3-4 (O(registry) fuzzy loops) -> Rust when registry exceeds ~2000 entries with miss-heavy refs; openplanter _find_subsequence (0.32-1.22ms/call at 5k lines) -> Rust only if patch sizes grow 10x; nothing in jev-ultrafast/armada/mindwalk qualifies (IO-bound, already-compiled, already-Go).
